card.name: Academic bios and citation details
card.fires_on: Words right after a scholar's name or title in biographies and citations, such as 'is' before a professorship, 'research' or 'senior' before a role, or a publisher or year.

modes.label: Scholar's title
modes.description: The word after a named academic that begins a role such as professor, fellow or director.
modes.example: John B. Cobb, Jr., Ph.D.<< is>> Professor of Theology Emeritus at the

modes.label: Publisher and year in citations
modes.description: Parts of a publisher name or a year inside a book citation.

modes.label: Role after expert name
modes.description: A job word or comma following a named researcher, before an affiliation.
modes.example: Eric Hanushek,<< senior>> fellow at the Hoover Institution at Stanford University

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a scholar's name, title, or book citation, where an institution or publisher comes next.
